notes.title: The Wolf's Den is Going Free!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

I just wanted to give a quick update regarding the state of the game. Starting in mid-October The Wolf's Den will transition from a paid game ($1.99 USD) to free! That's it, no strings attached, completely free! I wanted to thank everybody who supported and purchased the game, due to your support I was able to recoup the development costs. I really appreciate it. And thanks to all of you who left a review and gave feedback on the game (both good and bad). I look to make more (better) games in the future, so please keep an eye out for anything new!

Cheers,
Takoyaki

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1a
notes.notes:
Thanks to all who bought the game! This is a small patch to fix the following issues:

[olist]
[*] The mouse cursor should now be properly locked to the game window on the menu, pause screen, journal pages, and during any cutscenes. This should hopefully help fix problems where the mouse could wander off screen and move the game out of focus preventing user input.
[*] Fixed a typo in one the item descriptions.
[/olist]
If you encounter any issues that prevent you from enjoying the game feel free to reach out! I'm more than happy to address them if possible!

- Takoyaki
